notes.testing: TSR on strogatz_bacres1 at ceiling 2, 180 s, seed 7014. NOTE: the sweep's own fit died at 79 s of its 180 s budget with no final report and no error. It does NOT reproduce -- rerunning the identical command by hand finished cleanly at exit 0, so it was external (most likely GPU contention with another agent's concurrent fits on this machine), not a TSR fault. The numbers below are the clean rerun, kept as run_rerun.log beside the truncated original.
notes.outcome: Not recovered, which is what 800+400 has always done on bacres1. 7,240 generations in 180 s = 24.9 ms/generation. train 1-R2 3.611e-6, validation 1.056e-7, log10 p -17.88. 977,802 genes refused on type = 3.75% of gene-slots per generation; 0 oversized. Depth histogram 0:1702 1:490 2:1215 3:133 4:30 5:18 6:10 7:1 8:1 -- 1,215 genes at the ceiling, so T2 is live here too. The 24.9 ms/generation is FASTER than the 26.9 the untyped engine ran at 420 s earlier in this session, which is the opposite of the 10% pace tax that run suggested; the two differ in budget and in machine load, so neither number should be read as the pace cost on its own.
